draws.source: protennislive.com official ATP draw sheets (mds = main draw, qs = qualifying)

sources.pointsTable: 2026 ATP Official Rulebook §9.03 G.5 (Singles Point table), p.272-273

rules.dropDate: Every row of an event drops on the event's award Monday + 52 weeks (award Monday = the Monday after the last main-draw match). Qualifying-only rows drop with the main draw (ATP Rulebook §9.01 E: each tournament stays in the system 52 weeks).
rules.luckyLoser: A lucky loser shows main-draw points only; qualifyingPoints null (dash), ll true, pointsComplete false — the ATP rule for an LL's qualifying points is not confirmed from an official source.
rules.qualifying: Qualifying round from the api-tennis qualifying-bracket label (Final = last round). Last-round loss = Q_final_round_loss; the round before = Q_earlier_round_loss (null → 0); earlier = 0.
rules.zeroRows: Players whose result is worth 0 points are in zeroRows, not rows.
rules.status: Playing = in the official draw sheet; Withdrew = named in the sheet's withdrawals (statusInferred false) or on an acceptance list but not in the draw (statusInferred true); Not entered otherwise.

lyon-2026.name: Lyon
lyon-2026.note: Lyon 2026 (October, indoor hard) is a new event: firstEdition, no rows. Not Lyon May (clay), not Marseille, not Stockholm.
